issue.title: Area and project cards with a bob-validated settings editor
issue.description: Every area and project note opens with a calm property card (an Area Card or a Project Card) that says what the home is, where it sits, its lifecycle, and the policies it declares. `=+` (and `==`) edit every area/project setting through typed, inheritance-aware stages that bob validates and writes byte-preservingly. Once no second frontmatter writer remains, the cards take over native Properties on these notes, bank.md included, and every failure path brings native Properties back.
